payload.text: hv, 2026-11-03 after ST0002's close: a release is one command, and pplr and cldr both release signed and notarised the same way. Utilz already does (its after: runs tools/post-cut), so this is pplr's config, not devbin's: release.after: is one line, bin/devbin post-cut, which in a detached worktree at the tag builds, runs macos prepare, attaches with release attach --from dist/release, then formula publish, and pulls this machine's tap, stopping at the first failure; a re-run skips what is done. Reverses decision 25's by-hand formula publish and supersedes decision 26's devbin changes. Next: Cldr gets the same (devbin installed, a signer and a post-cut), in Cldr's repo.
